provenance.criteria: Each complete cohort must have no fewer XG best-move matches and a smaller mean absolute EV gap for XG-preferred moves than its five-ply baseline. This is targeted validation on a selected cohort, not an independent general-strength test.

nativeBuild.compiler:
Apple clang version 21.0.0 (clang-2100.1.1.101)
Target: arm64-apple-darwin25.5.0
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Toolchains/XcodeDefault.xctoolchain/usr/bin

cohort: Complete all 13440 planned records, all 45 retained moves, and provenance checks.
Full/strong must reduce mean absolute fixed-pair gap difference from XG versus the fresh Short baseline.
Full/strong must have at least as many fixed-pair mean preferences for XG as the fresh Short baseline.
At least one predeclared cohort-average cutoff or checker effect must shift toward XG under the new two-comparison simultaneous interval.

If accepted, promote all 15 positions and every retained move together at the same Full/strong policy. Replace the complete four-move opening entry with the separate 32768-trial precision study regardless of its winning move. No selective reply promotion.
opening: If the cohort fails its new criteria, opening 21 may qualify separately using only its independent 32768-trial study.
All three paired Full/strong XG-versus-other-retained-move intervals must have positive lower bounds under their three-comparison simultaneous family.
Full/strong must reduce absolute split-minus-slot gap difference from XG versus its fresh Short baseline.
At least one cutoff or checker effect must shift toward XG under its two-comparison simultaneous interval.
If accepted separately, replace all four opening alternatives together and preserve all reply entries.

replyFullgamePrecision.criterion: Complete fixed sample; all six unchanged-policy positions refined together regardless of winner.
